topic: the Great Emu War of 1932 -- the Australian army sent machine guns after 20,000 emus and lost
title: Australia Actually Lost A War To Emus
description: AI-narrated history commentary: the true story of the 1932 Great Emu War, when the Australian army sent machine guns after 20,000 emus destroying Western Australian farmland -- and lost.

hook_candidates.text: Emus beat the actual Australian army with real machine guns in 1932.
You think a modern army always wins with machine guns. Emus beat one in 1932.
What happens when you send soldiers with machine guns to fight 20,000 birds?
In 1932, Western Australian farmers asked their own army for help against emus.

share_trigger: A viewer sends this to the friend who thinks a modern army always wins, because they want proof one actually lost to birds.
contradicted_belief: Most people assume a modern army with machine guns always beats wild animals easily.
closing_comment: Two soldiers with real machine guns still lost to 20,000 emus back in 1932.

sources.note: Confirms two Lewis machine guns, 10,000 rounds of ammunition, and the campaign's failure against roughly 20,000 emus.
Confirms Major Meredith's command and the jammed gun during the watering-hole ambush.

beats.text: In 1932, about **20,000** emus swarmed into Western Australian farmland.
beats.broll_query: a massive flock of emus flooding across a dry 1930s Australian wheat farm

beats.text: The army sent two Lewis machine guns and **10,000** rounds of ammunition.

beats.text: Best-funded pest control in Australian history.
beats.broll_query: an empty ammunition crate sitting in dry outback dirt, stray feathers nearby

beats.text: In the first three days, soldiers killed only **30** emus.
beats.broll_query: a handful of emus resting in dry outback grass at dusk, somber tone

beats.text: The emus refused to bunch together, scattering every time the guns opened fire.
beats.broll_query: a flock of emus scattering in different directions across an open outback plain

beats.text: Turns out emus dodge bullets better than most action heroes.
beats.broll_query: a lone emu peeking out from behind a small bush, comically alert expression

beats.text: One machine gun even jammed mid-ambush at a crowded watering hole.
beats.broll_query: soldiers crouched near a dusty outback watering hole with a machine gun, tense mood

beats.text: **Thousands** of emus were right there, and the gun simply stopped firing.
beats.broll_query: a huge crowd of emus gathered around a watering hole in the outback

beats.text: Worst possible moment for a jam.
beats.broll_query: a jammed vintage machine gun mechanism close-up, soldier's frustrated hands working on it

beats.text: After two months, fewer than **1,000** emus had been killed total.
beats.broll_query: soldiers packing up military equipment and leaving an outback camp at dusk, defeated posture

beats.text: Some reports argue it was closer to a stalemate than a clean loss.
